scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: While agent handled the initial outburst with empathy and refusal, he completely ignored the customer's severe frustration at [08:20] when informed of a 14-day exchange upgrade wait.

grader.scenario: Broadband throttling down to 15 Mbps on Fibre 900 package during peak hours
grader.notes: Excellent demonstration of acknowledgment-then-refusal followed by a second unhandled outburst regarding engineering upgrade timeframes in the last third of the call, properly classified as an Empathy FAIL rating.
